newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece clears construction firm Etane IPO.
newsitem.headline: Greece clears construction firm Etane IPO.

text.p: Greece's capital markets commission cleared the initial public offering prospectus of construction firm Etane for listing on the Athens bourse's small-cap parallel market.

Etane will issue 400,000 common registered shares with a par value of 100 drachmas, as well as a 20,000 share tranche which will be privately placed, lead underwriter and issue advisor Telesis Securities said in a statement on Tuesday.
The issue price will be announced at a later date.
But it should fall in the 1,800-1,900 drachma range based on targeted proceeds of 750-800 million drachmas cited by Telesis Securities.
The subscription period was provisionally set for late May to early June 1997.
Etane specialises in prefabricated construction, renovation and rehabilitation of landmark buildings and is a member of Europe's 500 --an association of fast growing European companies.
It yielded after-tax profits of 402 million drachmas on turnover of 2.294 billion in fiscal 1996.
The company will use IPO proceeds to finance equipment acquisition, boost working capital and reduce debt.
